title: SigHeavyGit heavy git
description: Signature Heavy Git is a Signature original: large-file versioning for Git where big binaries live in a content store and tiny SigPointers live in the repo, with pattern tracking, file locking, and any-protocol servers — the Signature take on binary versioning. Its pointer format, protocol, and tooling are original Signature designs.

print('siggit track "*.gguf"  # binaries versioned, repo stays lean')
print('edition: Signature original')
